title: Run package and skill builds in CI
author: claude
head: f5f72ec0ff5e06e9d6f8367a670eb35cb796b558
body:
## Summary

Follow-up to #15. The CI workflow ran typecheck, format check, tests and the viewer build, but not `npm run build:ts` or `npm run build:skill`, so a broken `npm run build` would only surface at publish time (`prepublishOnly`).

This adds two steps to the existing job so CI covers the full `npm run build`:

- **Build package** — `npm run build:ts` (tsc emit + copy `schema.sql` into `dist/db/`)
- **Package skill** — `npm run build:skill` (zips `skill/` into `dist/coach-skill.zip`; `zip` is preinstalled on `ubuntu-latest`)

Pinned action SHAs, read-only `contents` permission and the Node 22 setup are unchanged. The job's display name is updated from "…build viewer" to "…build"; `main` has no required status checks, so nothing depends on the old name.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run build:ts` and `npm run build:skill` pass locally on this branch (produces `dist/db/schema.sql` and `dist/coach-skill.zip`)
- [x] `prettier --check` passes on the workflow file
- [ ] CI run on this PR is green

    exit 0
else

    exit 1
fi
